tasks.description: Add a search box to the app's main interface, allowing users to input their queries. The search box should be prominently displayed and easily accessible. Ensure the search box is responsive and works well on various devices.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is on the app's main page, when they click on the search box, then the cursor is placed in the search box for input.

tasks.description: Develop a backend service to handle search queries from the search box. This service should process the query, search the database, and return relevant results. Ensure the service is efficient and can handle a large volume of queries.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user submits a search query, when the query is processed by the backend service, then relevant results are returned to the user.

tasks.description: Implement a feature to display search results to the user. Results should be displayed in a user-friendly manner, with relevant information such as titles, descriptions, and links to the corresponding pages. Ensure the results are updated dynamically as the user types.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user submits a search query, when the results are displayed, then the results are relevant to the query and include necessary information.

tasks.description: Develop a feature to filter search results based on user input. This could include filtering by category, date, or relevance. Ensure the filtering functionality is intuitive and easy to use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user applies a filter to the search results, when the results are updated, then the results match the applied filter.

tasks.description: Create comprehensive tests for the search functionality to ensure it works as expected. Tests should cover various scenarios, including different user inputs, edge cases, and error handling. Ensure the tests are automated and run regularly.
acceptance_criteria: Given the search functionality is tested, when the tests are run, then all tests pass without errors.
